facts.fact: L'Observateur reports Djibouti presented the main lines of its first national AI strategy (SNIA) for 2026-2030 and launched it, with six priority axes; the document gives no event date, so the published date 2026-09-08 is used.

We Are Tech Africa reports Djibouti launched a structured process to define its future national AI strategy with UN support: the Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation held a national diagnostic phase and a multi-stakeholder workshop the week before, whose contributions will feed the final version.

slug: 2026-01-29 Djibouti develops national AI strategy with UN support

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports Djibouti is developing its first National AI Strategy, led by the education, innovation and digital ministry (MENIDjib) with UNESCO and UN-ESCWA support, beginning with a UNESCO readiness-assessment diagnostic; the document gives no event date, so the published date 2026-01-29 is used.

ESCWA reports that on 22 January 2026 it and Djibouti's Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation held a consultative workshop on the current draft of the national AI strategy, in preparation for its official adoption.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation (MDENI)

facts.fact: RTD reports the digital economy ministry (MDENI) officially launched on 22 January 2026 the preparatory work, a diagnostic and drafting workshop, for the national AI strategy 2026-2030, with UN representation.

La Nation reports that the UNESCO-backed readiness assessment (RAM) will serve as the basis of Djibouti's national AI strategy, which is still to be officially launched at the national AI forum opening 1 September 2026; no strategy is yet adopted.
